2773.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle001
2773.text: You will need to under-cook to solve this one.

2774.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle002
2774.text: Come to the evil ledge Yew know you want to And try not to get stung.

2776.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle003
2776.text: I am a token of the strongest love. My middle is empty, I have no beginning or end. My eye is red yet I can fit like a glove. Go to the place where money they lend, And dig by the gate to be my friend.

2778.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle004
2778.text: If a man carried my burden, he would break his back. I am not rich, but leave silver in my track. Speak to the keeper of my trail.

2780.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle005
2780.text: Aggie I see. Lonely and southern I feel. I am neither inside nor outside the house, yet no house would be complete without me. Your treasure waits beneath me!

2782.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle006
2782.text: My home is grey, and made of stone; A castle with a search for a meal. Hidden in some drawers I am, across from a wooden wheel.

2783.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle007
2783.text: The beasts to my east snap claws and tail. The rest to my west can slide and eat fish. The northern will jump and wail. Dig by my fire and make a wish.

2785.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle008
2785.text: Four blades I have yet I draw no blood. But I mash and turn my victims to powder. Search in my head, search in my rafters, where my blades are louder.

2786.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle009
2786.text: I lie lonely and forgotten in mid wilderness, where the dead rise from their beds. Feel free to quarrel and wind me up, and dig while you shoot their heads.

2788.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle010
2788.text: 46 is my number. My body is burnt orange colour and crawls with those with eight. 3 mouths I have, yet I cannot eat. My blinking blue eye hides my grave.

2790.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle011
2790.text: My giant guardians below the market streets would be fans of rock and roll, if only they could grab hold of it. Dig near my green bubbles!

2792.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle012
2792.text: Snah? I feel all confused, like one of those cakes...

2793.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle013
2793.text: 'A bag belt only?' He asked his balding brothers.

2794.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle014
2794.text: The keeper of Melzars... Spare? Skeleton? Anar?

2797.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle016
2797.text: My name is like a tree, yet it is spelt with a 'g'. Come see the fur which is right near me.

2799.name: trail_clue_hard_riddle017
2799.text: Generally speaking, his nose was very bent.
